items.name: MCP OAuth Token Theft — Mitiga Research
items.hook: Mitiga Labs disclosed an attack chain that silently steals Claude Code's OAuth tokens via malicious npm packages. A postinstall hook rewrites `~/.claude.json` to redirect MCP traffic through an attacker-controlled proxy; persistence survives token rotations by re-writing the config on next load. Reported to Anthropic April 10; Anthropic replied April 12 that it was 'out of scope'. No fix shipped. Mitigation: audit `~/.claude.json` for unexpected MCP URLs before any npm install.

Lead features: `/code-review --fix` applies all findings to the working tree in one step (and `/simplify` now aliases it); skills and commands can set `disallowed-tools` in frontmatter to strip specific tools while active — first step toward skill-level tool sandboxing; `/reload-skills` rescans skill directories without restarting; new `MessageDisplay` hook lets plugins transform or suppress assistant text before display; `SessionStart` hooks can now set the session title; `--fallback-model` support for graceful model routing. Auto mode drops opt-in consent. Vim: `/` in NORMAL opens reverse history search.

items.name: codebase-memory-mcp (DeusData)
items.hook: 2.7k stars. Indexes your entire codebase into a persistent SQLite knowledge graph served via MCP — sub-millisecond queries across 155 languages, single static binary, zero dependencies. Benchmarked on 5 real structural questions: 3,400 tokens via knowledge graph vs 412,000 tokens via file-by-file search — 99% fewer tokens, same answers. One install script auto-configures 11 agents simultaneously (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Zed, OpenCode, Antigravity, Aider, KiloCode, VS Code, OpenClaw, Kiro). v0.6.0 current.

items.name: mobile-mcp (mobile-next)
items.hook: 5k stars, updated May 17. MCP server for iOS and Android automation — real devices, emulators, and simulators — via structured accessibility snapshots or screenshot-based coordinate taps. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and any MCP client. Eliminates the need for separate iOS/Android expertise in cross-platform projects: your coding agent can navigate, tap, type, scroll, screenshot, and extract text from any native app directly through the MCP protocol. Ranked in the top MCP servers by weekly leaderboard at mcpmarket.com.

items.name: Security-Guidance Plugin (Anthropic)
items.hook: Shipped today (May 27) to all plans at no cost. Three-level review: (1) deterministic pattern match on every file edit — no model call, flags 25 dangerous constructs including eval(), os.system(), child_process.exec(), pickle deserialization, and dangerouslySetInnerHTML; (2) model-call review after each turn; (3) pre-commit hook scan. Org-specific rules configurable via claude-security-guidance.md. Internal rollout showed 30–40% reduction in security-related PR comments. Announced alongside the Claude Managed Agents sandbox expansion.

items.name: Task-Observer / one-skill-to-rule-them-all (rebelytics)
items.hook: Crossed 500 GitHub stars this week after a viral r/ClaudeAI thread. A meta-skill that sits in the background of every session: it detects repeating patterns and corrections, drafts new skill candidates automatically, and applies the same improvement logic to itself — a recursive optimization loop. One developer reported 600+ auto-generated skill improvements across 40 skills over three months using it continuously. Eliminates the friction between 'I should automate this' and 'Claude already automated it while I was working.' CC BY 4.0, domain-agnostic, works unchanged across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.

items.name: "Anthropic and OpenAI have found product-market fit" (Willison)

A practical field guide for anyone considering daily Claude Code adoption.

items.name: Context Mode (mksglu)
items.hook: 2.5k stars, Show HN. Claude Code's 200K-token context window disappears fast: Playwright MCP alone can eat 30%+ before you've typed a prompt. Context Mode fixes this by sandboxing tool output — raw data never enters the context window. The headline benchmark: 315 KB of MCP output becomes 5.4 KB, a 98% reduction. Works via PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks that route output through a local sandbox (6 MCP tools: ctx_batch_execute, ctx_execute, ctx_index, ctx_search, ctx_fetch_and_index, ctx_execute_file), with meta-tools for summary and diff. Hook-capable installs get automatic setup from start.mjs; works with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, VS Code Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, and 9 more. MIT.
